title: A Stranger's Welcome
storyPurpose: Establish the player's cover identity and introduce San Diego.
learningObjective: Ibarra's homecoming after seven years studying in Europe, and the social tension it creates.

objectives.description: Overhear the reception gossip from the market/kitchen staff
See Ibarra briefly in the plaza the next morning

historicalExplanation: Ilustrados like Ibarra (and Rizal himself) often returned from European study to a colonial society deeply suspicious of the reformist ideas they brought back.
